$comment: Claudius dependency manifest. Claudius ORCHESTRATES these tools; it never vendors or installs them — each 'fix' is the tool's own native command. Adding a dependency is a JSON edit, not a code change.

checks.label: Node.js
checks.why: runs the installer, doctor, and backup scripts

checks.label: git
checks.why: worktree chips and the merge step

checks.label: agents installed
checks.why: the pinned-model writers, planner, and advisors

checks.label: doctrine block
checks.why: makes dispatch always-on in every session

checks.label: verify gate model
checks.why: which model runs the verification pass (default opus; escalates to fable for high-stakes work)

checks.label: settings backup
checks.why: snapshot of settings.json + CLAUDE.md before any installer can clobber them

checks.label: RTK
checks.why: compresses noisy command output 30-90% before it reaches context
checks.fix: install rtk (brew install rtk, or a release binary)

checks.label: RTK hook registered
checks.why: the PreToolUse hook that rewrites Bash calls through rtk
checks.fix: rtk init -g  — CAUTION: rewrites settings.json; back it up first (node backup-settings.mjs)
checks.note: If RTK's banner claims 'No hook installed' while this check passes, suspect a UTF-8 BOM in settings.json (see the settings-bom check) — a BOM breaks RTK's parse of the file so it cannot see its own hook. Fix the BOM, not the hook. Never run `rtk init -g` to chase the banner.

checks.label: settings.json BOM-free
checks.why: a UTF-8 BOM (written by PowerShell redirects like > or Set-Content) breaks strict JSON parsers — it is what made RTK report 'No hook installed' while the hook was in fact registered and saving ~31%
checks.fix: rewrite settings.json as UTF-8 without BOM (in PowerShell: Set-Content -Encoding utf8NoBOM, or use a plain editor)

checks.label: ponytail
checks.why: code-necessity layer: the laziness ladder cuts LOC (~-54% claimed) before code is written. Its SubagentStart hook injects into Claudius writer subagents automatically, so Claudius does not duplicate the ruleset
checks.fix: claude plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail && claude plugin install ponytail@ponytail
checks.note: Orthogonal to caveman (prose terseness) and RTK (command output) — all three cut different axes. Costs ~676 tok always-on.

checks.label: find-skills
checks.why: reuse-before-reinvent: search existing skills before hand-rolling
checks.fix: npx -y skills add vercel-labs/skills --skill find-skills --agent claude-code -g

checks.label: Codex CLI
checks.why: host for the Codex companion layer
checks.fix: install the Codex CLI (optional — only needed for the codex/ layer)

checks.label: Codex companion installed
checks.why: mirrors the dispatch doctrine into Codex
checks.note: EXPERIMENTAL: inline model pinning in the agent TOMLs is unverified against codex 0.125.0 — confirm a role actually resolves at gpt-5.5/xhigh before relying on the routing.

checks.label: Bun
checks.why: runtime + worker process manager required by claude-mem
checks.fix: npm i -g bun   (blocks the claude-mem trial until present)

checks.label: claude-mem
checks.why: cross-session memory layer; would fix chip/subagent context loss
checks.fix: npx claude-mem install   (scoped trial first — needs Bun)

checks.label: Impeccable
checks.why: design-quality gate for UI work; P1 findings block a chip merge
checks.fix: npx impeccable install   (then /impeccable init per UI project)
